# Catch missing-detail guidance regressions before shipping

## What & Why
The answer and opportunity dialogs now provide field-specific validation, but the browser suite does not assert the visible messages or their accessibility wiring. A focused regression test will protect this recovery path.

## Done looks like
- Empty answer submission asserts both title and answer-content messages
- Empty opportunity submission asserts company and role messages
- Tests verify aria-invalid and aria-describedby point to the visible messages
- Filling each missing field removes only that field's message

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
